instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ahmed Shakir Abd Al-Rida
subject: 03_Data_Mining

questions.question: What does classification assign to a data record?
options: a numerical value on a continuous scale
a fixed order of validation records
one of a set of predefined classes
options_en: a numerical value on a continuous scale
a fixed order of validation records
one of a set of predefined classes
questions.explanation: It is used to assign a data record to one of a set of predefined classes.

questions.question: What makes classification a supervised-learning technique?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي يجعل التصنيف تقنية تعلّم خاضع للإشراف؟
options: the test data is used to fit the model
evaluating only the final model on unseen data
the algorithm discovers groups without target classes
the training data contains the correct answers
options_en: the test data is used to fit the model
evaluating only the final model on unseen data
the algorithm discovers groups without target classes
the training data contains the correct answers
options_ar: تقييم النموذج النهائي فقط على بيانات غير مرئية
تكتشف الخوارزمية مجموعات من دون فئات مستهدفة
تحتوي بيانات التدريب على الإجابات الصحيحة
questions.explanation: The term supervised means that the training data contains the correct answers.
questions.explanation_ar: تحتوي بيانات التدريب على الإجابات الصحيحة

questions.question: Which term is also used for features?
What is the class label also commonly called?
questions.question_ar: بماذا تسمى تسمية الفئة أيضاً عادة؟
questions.explanation: The class label is also commonly called the target variable.

questions.question: What is training data used for?
options: a numerical value on a continuous scale
one of a set of predefined classes
options_en: a numerical value on a continuous scale
one of a set of predefined classes
questions.explanation: Training data is the data used to teach the classification algorithm.

questions.question: Which labels are included in training data?
Which model-selection task can validation data support?
questions.question_ar: أي مهمة لاختيار النموذج يمكن أن تدعمها بيانات التحقق؟
options: one of a set of predefined classes
options_en: one of a set of predefined classes

questions.question: Which model problem can validation data help detect?
questions.question_ar: أي مشكلة في النموذج يمكن لبيانات التحقق أن تساعد على اكتشافها؟
questions.explanation: Pruning helps avoid overfitting by removing unnecessary branches.

questions.question: What is test data used to evaluate?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي تستخدم بيانات الاختبار لتقييمه؟
questions.explanation: Test data is used to evaluate the final classification model.

questions.question: A team uses its test records while fitting the classifier. Which rule does this violate?
questions.question_ar: يستخدم فريق سجلات الاختبار أثناء ملاءمة المصنف. أي قاعدة يخالف؟
options: The training data must contain known class labels.
The model should not use the test data during training.
Validation data can help select between models.
the algorithm discovers groups without target classes
options_en: The training data must contain known class labels.
The model should not use the test data during training.
Validation data can help select between models.
the algorithm discovers groups without target classes
options_ar: يجب أن تحتوي بيانات التدريب على تسميات فئات معروفة.
ينبغي ألا يستخدم النموذج بيانات الاختبار أثناء التدريب.
يمكن لبيانات التحقق أن تساعد على الاختيار بين النماذج.
تكتشف الخوارزمية مجموعات من دون فئات مستهدفة
questions.explanation: The model should not use the test data during training.
questions.explanation_ar: ينبغي ألا يستخدم النموذج بيانات الاختبار أثناء التدريب.

questions.question: What does the algorithm learn by examining training data?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تتعلم الخوارزمية من فحص بيانات التدريب؟
options: a list of classes without input features
the percentage of all predictions that are correct
patterns that distinguish one class from another
a numerical value on a continuous scale
options_en: a list of classes without input features
the percentage of all predictions that are correct
patterns that distinguish one class from another
a numerical value on a continuous scale
options_ar: قائمة فئات من دون خصائص إدخال
questions.explanation: It tries to learn patterns that distinguish one class from another.
